cards.quote: There are two broad classifications: high-level or low-level waste.
cards.stem: What broad groupings are used to classify radioactive waste

cards.hint: Think about used reactor fuel described as primary source
options: spent fuel removed from reactors after producing electricity
cards.quote: High-level waste is primarily spent fuel removed from reactors after producing electricity.
cards.stem: What material makes up most high-level waste

cards.hint: Recall the lighter elements formed during splitting
cards.quote: These isotopes, called "fission products," account for most of the heat and penetrating radiation in high-level waste.

cards.hint: Think about protection and temperature control in pools
options: shield the radiation and cool the rods
separate uranium and plutonium for reuse
withdraw public lands for exclusive use
cards.quote: The water is typically about 40 feet deep and serves both to shield the radiation and cool the rods.
cards.stem: What functions does pool water serve for stored fuel
